# The Rise by Ruchira

> A RERA-registered luxury high-rise residential project by Ruchira Projects at Budigere Cross, East Bengaluru. 342 residences across two towers on a 4-acre site.

## Key Facts
- Project name: The Rise by Ruchira
- Developer: Ruchira Projects (13+ years in Bengaluru real estate, founded 2013)
- Location: Budigere Cross Junction, OMR Frontage, East Bengaluru, Karnataka 560049 (approx. 13.0442°N, 77.7433°E)
- Project type: Luxury high-rise residential
- Plot area: 4 acres
- Towers: 2 — Tower I (2B+G+2P+40, 42 floors, 6 units/floor, 223 units, 2/3 BHK + Duplex) and Tower II (2B+G+2P+32, 34 floors, 4 units/floor, 119 units, 3/3.5/4 BHK)
- Total height: 156 metres
- Total units: 342
- Configurations & super built-up area: 2 BHK 1443–1776 sqft (69 units) · 3 BHK 1826–2057 sqft (207 units) · 3.5 BHK 2609–2977 sqft (31 units) · 4 BHK 3261–3726 sqft (31 units) · Duplex 6891–6902 sqft (4 units)
- Open space: 70%
- Approval authority: Bangalore Development Authority (BDA)
- RERA status: Received. RERA No. PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/160726/008812
- Pre-launch price: ₹11,999 per sq. ft., all-inclusive (excludes PLC, FRC, corpus fund, maintenance & registration charges; valid for a limited period)
- Booking token: ₹5,00,000 (100% refundable without unit allotment; 10% cancellation charge after allotment)
- Status: Pre-launch, unit allotment open
- Density: 4–6 residences per floor, ~86 homes per acre
- Floor-to-floor height: 11 ft
- Amenities: 100+ including swimming pool, sky bridge connecting both towers, gymnasium, badminton/squash/pickle ball courts, amphitheatre, banquet & party hall, kids' play areas, creche, library & co-working spaces, 6 guest suite rooms, senior citizen leisure garden, pet park, theatre

## Nearby Landmarks (from the project's own location map)
- Connectivity: Budigere Cross Junction (at the doorstep), Kempegowda International Airport, STRR, Hoskote Toll Plaza, Old Madras Road (NH75), KR Puram Metro Station, Whitefield (Kadugodi) Metro & Railway Station
- Education: VIBGYOR High School, NPS (National Public School), Chrysalis High School (Marq), Cambridge Institute of Technology (CIT)
- Healthcare: Silicon City Hospital, MVJ Hospital, Taluk Government Hospital, Sathya Sai Orthopaedic & Multispeciality Hospital
- Retail/Work/Leisure: Orion Uptown Mall, Phoenix Marketcity, Bearys Global Research Triangle, ITPL Whitefield, PrimeGolf Brewing & Golfing, Innovative Multiplex, Geist Brewing Company

## Why Budigere Cross
- Connectivity to Whitefield, KR Puram, Kempegowda International Airport and Old Madras Road
- Upcoming Satellite Town Ring Road (STRR), Bangalore Business Corridor (BBC) and Metro expansion
- 11+ IT parks within a 15 km radius; 4–5 lakh+ working professionals in the catchment
- Over 80% price appreciation in the last 3 years
- Seegahalli 4.5 lakh sq.ft. lifestyle mall expected 2027
- 3 international schools confirmed within 2 km, opening 2027–2028
